The '''father''' of [[Bertroff Hissa]], a [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. He and [[Bertroff Hissa's mother|his wife]] were former [[Politics/Legends|political]] agitators who had relocated on the uncharted [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[PL-40112-CE-021105]] in search of a "simple and natural" lifestyle. He [[Death/Legends|died]] during a conflict that opposed the inhabitants of his new [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and the Imperials against the [[Rozzum]].<ref name="BT1" />
